description: Fetch records from a dataset on a Swiss Opendatasoft portal with ODSQL: where (e.g. "kanton = 'BS'", "jahr >= 2020", "search(name, 'Bahnhof')"), select (e.g. 'bahnhof_haltestelle, dtv, jahr'), order_by (e.g. 'dtv desc'), group_by with aggregates (select 'kanton, count(*) as n, sum(dtv) as total', group_by 'kanton'), limit/offset. Convenience `near` {lat, lon, radius_m} finds the dataset's geo_point_2d field and returns only records within the radius, sorted by distance (e.g. parking garages within 800 m of Basel SBB: portal 'basel-stadt', near {lat:47.5476, lon:7.5896, radius_m:800}). Real-time datasets (parking occupancy, SBB data) are cached only 10 min. Get field names first with get_portal_dataset.

geo_field.description: geo_point_2d field to use for `near` (auto-detected if omitted)

group_by.description: e.g. 'kanton' or 'year(datum)'; combine with aggregates in select

lang.description: Language for localized values where the portal supports it

near.description: Radius search around a WGS84 point, e.g. {lat: 47.5476, lon: 7.5896, radius_m: 500}

portal.description: Portal id, alias or domain: 'sbb' (data.sbb.ch), 'basel-stadt' (data.bs.ch), 'basel-landschaft' (data.bl.ch), 'st-gallen' (daten.sg.ch), 'stadt-st-gallen' (daten.stadt.sg.ch), 'graubuenden' (data.gr.ch), 'thurgau' (data.tg.ch); any other '<tenant>.opendatasoft.com' host also works

select.description: Fields/expressions to return, e.g. 'name, belegung, geo_point_2d' or 'kanton, count(*) as n'

where.description: ODSQL filter, e.g. "jahr = 2023 AND dtv > 10000" (string literals in single or double quotes)

name: query_portal_records
title: Query records of an Opendatasoft dataset
